proposals.title: DevSecOps Control Baseline Standard
proposals.statement: 0.2 | Aligned with Platform Reference Architecture Levels; clarified artifact integrity evidence and added requirement identifiers | 3/4/5

proposals.title: Aim and Purpose
proposals.statement: The Control Baseline specifies the minimum mandatory lifecycle controls and required evidence artifacts that must be implemented for all software developed within the scope of the DevSecOps Policy.

proposals.title: Aim and Purpose
proposals.statement: compliant with cybersecurity and safety requirements.

proposals.title: The Chief Digitalisation Office
proposals.statement: When a version is quoted, this version shall be used.

proposals.title: ISO/IEC 27001
proposals.statement: These frameworks inform the definition of lifecycle security controls and software supply chain integrity requirements.

proposals.title: Relationship to Platform Reference Architecture Levels
proposals.statement: The DevSecOps Platform Reference Architecture defines the minimum platform capabilities required to implement, enforce, and evidence those controls.

proposals.title: Relationship to Platform Reference Architecture Levels
proposals.statement: The required platform level shall therefore be derived from the applicable Control Baseline level.

proposals.title: Relationship to Platform Reference Architecture Levels
proposals.statement: Control Baseline Level | Required Platform Level | Purpose of Alignment

proposals.title: Control Objective
proposals.statement: Ensure traceability between requirements and implemented software and the corresponding Testcases and Reports.
